limitations: Equal symmetric competition strength, equal unit intrinsic growth and self-limitation, finite complete graphs with a deleted matching; outcome selection for multiple deleted edges requires pair-balanced and uniquely maximum initial pair populations; post-transition classification restricted to 1/2<alpha<1. Equivalent older formulae may exist.
scientific_integrity: A self-contained mathematical derivation is given; finite computational tests are corroboration only. Earlier general spectral, independent-set and stability results retain their priority. No independent validation is claimed.
title: A universal half-coupling transition for nearly complete competitive ecological networks
